pilot.evaluation_protocol: full ranking over all items not in the user's training set; Recall@20, NDCG@20
pilot.negative_source: implicit: all items the user has not interacted with in train
pilot.notes: different release and threshold from [P2]'s Amazon 2023 five-cores; no [P2] number re-used
pilot.rule_found_in_code_or_release: every release interaction is a 2014 Books rating (all 2984108), ratings 1-5 and years 1996-2014 all present, and the release is a 10-core internally; but the raw 10-core has 158650 users and 128939 items, of which the release keeps 52643 and 91599 (all inside the raw 10-core); rating thresholds, time windows and the reviews-with-text subset do not reproduce it
pilot.rule_stated_in_paper: 'we use the 10-core setting to ensure that each user and item have at least ten interactions'
pilot.sources_checked: NGCF Sec. 4.1.1 (cites He & McAuley 2016); LightGCN Sec. 4; kuandeng/LightGCN Data/amazon-book; Amazon 2014 ratings_Books.csv and reviews_Books_5.json.gz (mcauleylab.ucsd.edu)
pilot.verification: release checked against the raw 10-core (Jaccard users 0.3318, items 0.7104, pairs 0.6347; release inside the core); the extra reduction is not identified
